verses.greek: Χριστοῦ οὖν παθόντος σαρκὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὁπλίσασθε, ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας,
verses.literal: Christ therefore having suffered in the flesh also you yourselves the same mind do arm yourselves with because the one having suffered the flesh has himself done with sin
verses.dgt: Therefore, since Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same way of thinking, because the one who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

verses.greek: εἰς τὸ μηκέτι ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι θεοῦ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον.
verses.literal: so as the no longer to men’s desires but to the will of God the remaining in the flesh to live time.
verses.dgt: so as to live the remaining time in the flesh no longer for human desires but for the will of God.

verses.greek: ἀρκετὸς γὰρ ὁ παρεληλυθὼς χρόνος τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν κατειργάσθαι, πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις, ἐπιθυμίαις, οἰνοφλυγίαις, κώμοις, πότοις, καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις.
verses.literal: Is sufficient for the having past time the desire of the Gentiles to have carried out having walked in sensuality in lusts in drunkenness in orgies in carousing and in abominable idolatries
verses.dgt: For the time already past is sufficient for carrying out the desire of the Gentiles, having walked in sensuality, desires, drunkenness, revelries, drinking parties, and lawless idolatries.

verses.greek: ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν, βλασφημοῦντες·
verses.literal: With respect to this they think it strange not running with them of you into the same the of debauchery overflow denigrating you
verses.dgt: In this they are surprised that you do not run with them into the same flood of reckless living, and they blaspheme you.

verses.greek: οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ἔχοντι κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς·
verses.literal: who will give account to Him who ready is to judge the living and the dead.
verses.dgt: They will give account to the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

verses.greek: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκὶ ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ θεὸν πνεύματι.
verses.literal: To this end indeed even to the dead it was evangelised so that they may be judged indeed according to men in the flesh they may live however according to God in the spirit.
verses.dgt: For this reason the good news was announced even to the dead, so that though judged in the flesh according to humans, they might live in the spirit according to God.

verses.greek: Πάντων δὲ τὸ τέλος ἤγγικεν. σωφρονήσατε οὖν καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς·
verses.literal: Of all now the end has drawn near do be clear-minded therefore and do sober for the purpose of prayers
verses.dgt: But the end of all things has drawn near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober for prayers.

verses.greek: πρὸ πάντων τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ ἔχοντες, ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν·
verses.literal: above all things the among yourselves love fervent having because love covers over a multitude of sins.
verses.dgt: Above all, keep your love for one another earnest, because love covers a multitude of sins.

verses.literal: hospitable to one another without complaint
verses.dgt: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

verses.greek: ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα, εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος θεοῦ·
verses.literal: each even as has received a gift to each other them serving as good stewards of the manifold grace of God:
verses.dgt: As each has received a gift, serve one another with it, as good stewards of the varied grace of God.

verses.greek: εἴ τις λαλεῖ, ὡς λόγια θεοῦ· εἴ τις διακονεῖ, ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ θεός· ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.literal: if anyone speaks as oracles of God if anyone serves as of strength which supplies the God so that in all things may be glorified the God through Jesus Christ to whom be the glory and the power to the ages of the ages Amen.
verses.dgt: If anyone speaks, let it be as words of God; if anyone serves, let it be from the strength that God supplies, so that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος,
verses.literal: Beloved not do be surprised at the among you fire for a trial to you taking place as if a strange thing to you were happening
verses.dgt: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial among you that is happening to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε, ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι.
verses.literal: But as you have shared in the the of Christ sufferings do rejoice so that also in the revelation of the glory of Him you may rejoice exulting.
verses.dgt: But insofar as you share in the sufferings of Christ, rejoice, so that also at the revelation of his glory you may rejoice with exultation.

verses.greek: εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ, μακάριοι, ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ἀναπαύεται.
verses.literal: If you are insulted in the name of Christ you are blessed because the the of glory and the the of God the Spirit upon you rests
verses.dgt: If you are insulted in the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

verses.greek: μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος·
verses.literal: Not for any of you should suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as a troublesome meddler
verses.dgt: For let none of you suffer as a murderer or thief or evildoer or as a meddler in the affairs of others.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός, μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω, δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.
verses.literal: if however as a Christian not he should be ashamed he should glorify however the God in the name this.
verses.dgt: But if as a Christian, let that person not be ashamed, but let that person glorify God in this name.

verses.greek: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφʼ ἡμῶν, τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ;
verses.literal: For it is the time for the to have begun the judgment from the house the of God if now first from us what will be the outcome of those disobeying the the of God gospel?
verses.dgt: For it is time for judgment to begin from the household of God; and if first from us, what will be the outcome for those who disobey the good news of God?

verses.greek: καὶ εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σῴζεται, ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται;
verses.literal: And If the righteous one with difficulty is saved the ungodly and sinner where will appear?
verses.dgt: And “if the righteous is saved with difficulty, where will the ungodly and sinner appear?”

verses.greek: ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ πιστῷ κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ.
verses.literal: Therefore also those suffering according to the will the of God to the faithful Creator they should commit the souls of them in well doing.
verses.dgt: Therefore let those who suffer according to the will of God entrust their souls to a faithful Creator while doing good.
